description:
Title: Ordering in an Online Shop  

A customer that logs into an E-Shop system and has to wait for its login confirmation (its credentials are checked by the system).
If the login was successful then the customer can continue to select products, else the shopping experience stops.
After selecting a product the customer has to add it to a shopping cart, save the product and check if every product was already selected.
These steps repeat until all products were selected.
Then the order is finished by the shopping system and simultaneously payment and shipment for the order is prepared.
For the payment the customer has to enter its payment data and has to wait until the bank confirms the payment.
While waiting for the payment confirmation the customer can enter its shipping address (an independent billing address can be entered if the shipping address is not equal to the billing address).
Finally if the address and the payment steps are executed then the order will be finished by the system.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_OnlineShopOrdering" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/online-shop-ordering">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PaymentConfirmed" name="Payment confirmed"/>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_OnlineShopOrdering" name="Ordering in an Online Shop" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Roles">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Customer" name="Customer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Shopping</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_LogIn</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>GW_ProductMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectProduct</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AddToCart</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SaveProduct</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterPaymentData</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Catch_PaymentConfirmed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterShippingAddress</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>GW_AddressSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterBillingAddress</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>GW_AddressMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_EShopSystem" name="E-Shop System">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckCredentials</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>GW_LoginSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_ShoppingStopped</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckAllSelected</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>GW_AllSelected</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FinalizeOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>GW_ParallelSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PreparePayment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareShipment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>GW_ParallelJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CompleteOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_OrderCompleted</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Bank" name="Bank">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ConfirmPayment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Shopping" name="Customer starts shopping"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_LogIn" name="Log in to E-Shop"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CheckCredentials" name="Check credentials"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_LoginSplit" name="Login successful?" default="Flow_LoginFailed"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ShoppingStopped" name="Shopping stopped"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_ProductMerge" name="Merge product selection"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectProduct" name="Select product"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AddToCart" name="Add product to shopping cart"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SaveProduct" name="Save product"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CheckAllSelected" name="Check whether all products are selected"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_AllSelected" name="All products selected?"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_FinalizeOrder" name="Finalize order"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="GW_ParallelSplit" name="Start payment and shipment"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_PreparePayment" name="Prepare payment"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterPaymentData" name="Enter payment data"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConfirmPayment" name="Confirm payment"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_PaymentConfirmed" name="Wait for payment confirmation">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_PaymentConfirmed" messageRef="Message_PaymentConfirmed"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_PrepareShipment" name="Prepare shipment"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterShippingAddress" name="Enter shipping address"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_AddressSplit" name="Shipping address equals billing address?" default="Flow_AddressEqual"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterBillingAddress" name="Enter billing address"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_AddressMerge" name="Merge address branches"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="GW_ParallelJoin" name="Payment and address completed"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CompleteOrder" name="Finish order"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_OrderCompleted" name="Order finished"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_Shopping" targetRef="Task_LogIn"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_LogIn" targetRef="Task_CheckCredentials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_CheckCredentials" targetRef="GW_LoginSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LoginSuccess" name="Yes" sourceRef="GW_LoginSplit" targetRef="GW_ProductMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${loginSuccessful == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LoginFailed" name="No" sourceRef="GW_LoginSplit" targetRef="End_ShoppingStopped"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="GW_ProductMerge" targetRef="Task_SelectProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_SelectProduct" targetRef="Task_AddToCart"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_AddToCart" targetRef="Task_SaveProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_SaveProduct" targetRef="Task_CheckAllSelected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Task_CheckAllSelected" targetRef="GW_AllSelected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotAllSelected" name="No" sourceRef="GW_AllSelected" targetRef="GW_ProductMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${allProductsSelected == false}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AllSelected" name="Yes" sourceRef="GW_AllSelected" targetRef="Task_FinalizeOrder">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${allProductsSelected == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Task_FinalizeOrder" targetRef="GW_ParallelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="GW_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_PreparePayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="GW_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_PreparePayment" targetRef="Task_EnterPaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_EnterPaymentData" targetRef="Task_ConfirmPayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmPayment" targetRef="Catch_PaymentConfirmed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Catch_PaymentConfirmed" targetRef="GW_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_PrepareShipment" targetRef="Task_EnterShippingAddress"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_EnterShippingAddress" targetRef="GW_AddressSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AddressDiffers" name="No" sourceRef="GW_AddressSplit" targetRef="Task_EnterBillingAddress">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${addressesDiffer == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AddressEqual" name="Yes" sourceRef="GW_AddressSplit" targetRef="GW_AddressMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Task_EnterBillingAddress" targetRef="GW_AddressMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="GW_AddressMerge" targetRef="GW_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="GW_ParallelJoin" targetRef="Task_CompleteOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Task_CompleteOrder" targetRef="End_OrderCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
